jojoba-oil-macadamia-seed-oil-esters.distinctIngredients: Not simply a blend of the two original oils, and not synonymous with the multi-ingredient L22 blend.

sources.label: Jojoba Oil/Macadamia Seed Oil Esters — INKEEDecoder

lanolin.name: Lanolin
lanolin.summary: Softens rough-feeling skin and enriches creams.
lanolin.body: Lanolin is a refined wax obtained from sheep’s wool. It helps soften skin and can help oil and water blend in rich creams and ointments.
lanolin.caution: If you have a confirmed lanolin or wool-alcohol contact allergy, avoid lanolin-containing products. Allergy is more likely on already damaged or eczema-prone skin.
lanolin.aliasNotes: Refined sheep sebaceous wax, composed mainly of esters; it is an animal-derived ingredient.
lanolin.distinctIngredients: Lanolin is the whole wax mixture; Lanolin Alcohol is a separated alcohol fraction.

lanolin-alcohol.name: Lanolin Alcohol
lanolin-alcohol.summary: Softens skin and helps creams blend evenly.
lanolin-alcohol.body: Lanolin alcohol is a mixture separated from lanolin, the wax on sheep’s wool. It softens skin and helps creams combine oil and water while controlling their texture.
lanolin-alcohol.caution: Lanolin alcohol can cause an itchy allergic rash. Avoid it if allergy testing has identified lanolin or wool alcohols as a trigger for you.
lanolin-alcohol.aliasNotes: Alcohol fraction obtained by breaking down lanolin; includes a mixture of wax alcohols.
lanolin-alcohol.distinctIngredients: Separate from whole Lanolin and from ethanol.

lecithin.name: Lecithin
lecithin.summary: Softens skin and helps oil and water blend.
lecithin.body: Lecithin helps keep oil and water mixed in a formula while contributing a soft skin feel. It is a mixture of fat-like substances used in creams, lotions and other skin-care products.
lecithin.detail: It can also help form tiny fat-based capsules, called liposomes, that carry other ingredients within a formula.
lecithin.aliasNotes: Lecithin is a phospholipid-rich material rather than one universally pure molecule.
lecithin.distinctIngredients: Separate from hydrogenated lecithin, lysolecithin and purified phosphatidylcholine.

linoleic-acid.name: Linoleic Acid
linoleic-acid.summary: Helps skin feel softer and smoother.
linoleic-acid.body: Linoleic acid is an omega-6 fatty acid used to soften skin. It is also a building block of some of the fats in skin’s outer protective layer.
linoleic-acid.aliasNotes: The cis omega-6 fatty acid with double bonds at carbon positions 9 and 12.
linoleic-acid.distinctIngredients: Separate from linolenic acid, ethyl linoleate and plant oils that contain linoleic-acid fats.

linolenic-acid.name: Linolenic Acid
linolenic-acid.summary: Adds a fatty acid that softens skin.
linolenic-acid.body: Linolenic acid is an omega-3 fatty acid used to help skin feel soft and smooth. It is one of the fatty-acid ingredients that can be included in skin-care formulas.
linolenic-acid.aliasNotes: The page resolves this name to alpha-linolenic acid, CAS 463-40-1, with cis double bonds at 9, 12 and 15.
linolenic-acid.distinctIngredients: Different from linoleic acid and from gamma-linolenic acid.

linum-usitatissimum-linseed-seed-oil.name: Linum Usitatissimum (Linseed) Seed Oil
linum-usitatissimum-linseed-seed-oil.summary: Softens skin with flaxseed’s fatty oil.
linum-usitatissimum-linseed-seed-oil.body: Linseed oil, also called flaxseed oil, helps skin feel softer and smoother. It is a plant oil containing several fatty acids, including alpha-linolenic acid.
linum-usitatissimum-linseed-seed-oil.aliasNotes: Fixed oil expressed from dried, ripe Linum usitatissimum seeds.
linum-usitatissimum-linseed-seed-oil.distinctIngredients: Separate from linseed extract and isolated linolenic acid.

lysolecithin.name: Lysolecithin
lysolecithin.summary: Helps oil and water stay mixed.
lysolecithin.body: Lysolecithin is a modified form of lecithin that helps combine oil and water. It helps creams and lotions hold together as an even mixture.
lysolecithin.aliasNotes: Hydrolyzed lecithin: lecithin changed by breaking some chemical bonds with water.
lysolecithin.distinctIngredients: Separate from unmodified lecithin and hydrogenated lysolecithin.

meadowfoam-estolide.name: Meadowfoam Estolide
meadowfoam-estolide.summary: Helps skin feel soft and supple.
meadowfoam-estolide.body: Meadowfoam estolide is made by linking fatty-acid components from meadowfoam seed oil. It is used as a skin-softening ingredient and helps give formulas a smooth feel.
meadowfoam-estolide.aliasNotes: An oligomeric ester derived from Limnanthes alba seed-oil fatty acids.
meadowfoam-estolide.distinctIngredients: Separate from unmodified meadowfoam seed oil and from ceramides.

mineral-oil.name: Mineral Oil
mineral-oil.summary: Softens skin and slows moisture loss.
mineral-oil.body: Mineral oil helps skin feel smoother and reduces the amount of water that evaporates from its surface. It is an oily ingredient used to make moisturizers and cleansing products spread easily.
mineral-oil.aliasNotes: Cosmetic mineral oil is a highly refined liquid mixture of petroleum-derived hydrocarbons.
mineral-oil.distinctIngredients: Separate from semi-solid petrolatum and from unrefined or industrial mineral-oil grades.

olea-europaea-olive-fruit-oil.name: Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil
olea-europaea-olive-fruit-oil.summary: Softens skin with a rich plant oil.
olea-europaea-olive-fruit-oil.body: Olive fruit oil helps skin feel softer and smoother. It brings a rich, oily component to creams, lotions and cleansing products.
olea-europaea-olive-fruit-oil.aliasNotes: Fixed oil from ripe Olea europaea fruit.
olea-europaea-olive-fruit-oil.distinctIngredients: Separate from olive leaf extract, ethylhexyl olivate and olive-oil unsaponifiables.

oleic-acid.name: Oleic Acid
oleic-acid.summary: Softens skin and helps oil and water blend.
oleic-acid.body: Oleic acid is a fatty acid that can soften skin and help oil and water mix in a formula. Its role as a separate ingredient differs from its presence within a plant oil.
oleic-acid.aliasNotes: The cis omega-9 fatty acid, 9-octadecenoic acid.
oleic-acid.distinctIngredients: Free oleic acid is not interchangeable with olive oil or other oils containing oleic-acid fats.

olus-oil-vegetable-oil-huile-v-g-tale.name: Olus Oil/Vegetable Oil/Huile végétale
olus-oil-vegetable-oil-huile-v-g-tale.summary: Softens skin with a plant-oil mixture.
olus-oil-vegetable-oil-huile-v-g-tale.body: Olus oil is a general name for oil of plant origin used to soften skin. It contributes an oily component to a product, but the name does not identify a particular plant.
olus-oil-vegetable-oil-huile-v-g-tale.amountAndUse: The name alone does not reveal which plant oil or blend was used.
olus-oil-vegetable-oil-huile-v-g-tale.aliasNotes: Expressed vegetable-origin oil consisting mainly of fatty-acid triglycerides.
olus-oil-vegetable-oil-huile-v-g-tale.distinctIngredients: Separate from hydrogenated vegetable oil and from named single-plant oils.

palmitic-acid.name: Palmitic Acid
palmitic-acid.summary: Softens skin and helps shape creamy formulas.
palmitic-acid.body: Palmitic acid is a fatty acid that helps skin feel smooth and helps oil and water mix. In cleansers, it can also contribute to the product’s cleansing and foaming system.
palmitic-acid.distinctIngredients: Separate from palmitate esters such as cetyl palmitate and ethylhexyl palmitate.

petrolatum.name: Petrolatum
petrolatum.summary: Forms a film that slows skin’s water loss.
petrolatum.body: Petrolatum, commonly called petroleum jelly, coats skin with a moisture-retaining layer. This helps soften dry-feeling skin and is useful in rich balms and ointments.
petrolatum.amountAndUse: Its semi-solid texture can leave a noticeable greasy film; the amount and other ingredients shape the finished product’s feel.
petrolatum.distinctIngredients: Separate from liquid mineral oil. Vaseline is a brand name and is not recorded as an exact ingredient alias.

phosphatidylcholine.name: Phosphatidylcholine
phosphatidylcholine.summary: Helps oil and water form an even mixture.
phosphatidylcholine.body: Phosphatidylcholine helps combine oil and water in creams and lotions. It also serves a skin-conditioning role within the finished formula.
phosphatidylcholine.aliasNotes: Phosphatidylcholine is a specific phospholipid type; source materials can vary.
phosphatidylcholine.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from the broader Lecithin and Phospholipids names, and from Hydrogenated Phosphatidylcholine.

phospholipids.name: Phospholipids
phospholipids.summary: Softens skin and helps oil and water mix.
phospholipids.body: Phospholipids are a family of fats that help soften skin and bring oil and water together in a formula. They are also components of the membranes surrounding living cells.
phospholipids.detail: Some formulas use phospholipids to make tiny fat-based capsules called liposomes, which can hold other ingredients.
phospholipids.aliasNotes: Broad phospholipid family; the label does not specify one individual molecule.
phospholipids.distinctIngredients: Not synonymous with phosphatidylcholine alone or with hydrogenated phospholipids.

phytosteryl-macadamiate.name: Phytosteryl Macadamiate
phytosteryl-macadamiate.summary: Helps skin feel smoother and more supple.
phytosteryl-macadamiate.body: Phytosteryl macadamiate combines plant sterols, fat-like substances, with fatty acids from macadamia oil. It is used to help condition skin and contribute a soft feel.
phytosteryl-macadamiate.aliasNotes: Plant-sterol esters of macadamia-oil fatty acids.
phytosteryl-macadamiate.distinctIngredients: Separate from macadamia seed oil and from the whole L22 blend.

phytosteryl-sunflowerseedate.name: Phytosteryl Sunflowerseedate
phytosteryl-sunflowerseedate.summary: Helps keep skin in good condition.
phytosteryl-sunflowerseedate.body: Phytosteryl sunflowerseedate is made by joining sunflower-oil fatty acids to plant sterols, which are fat-like substances. It is a skin-conditioning ingredient used in richer skin-care formulas.
phytosteryl-sunflowerseedate.aliasNotes: Plant-sterol ester of sunflower seed-oil fatty acids.
phytosteryl-sunflowerseedate.distinctIngredients: Separate from sunflower seed oil and from the multi-ingredient blends containing this ester.

prunus-amygdalus-dulcis-sweet-almond-oil.name: Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil
prunus-amygdalus-dulcis-sweet-almond-oil.summary: Softens dry-feeling skin and adds smooth slip
prunus-amygdalus-dulcis-sweet-almond-oil.body: Sweet Almond Oil helps soften skin and gives a product an oily, smooth glide. It is used in creams and oils to make dry-feeling skin feel more comfortable.
prunus-amygdalus-dulcis-sweet-almond-oil.detail: The oil contains fatty-acid-rich fats that give it its softening feel.
prunus-amygdalus-dulcis-sweet-almond-oil.aliasNotes: Fixed oil from the ripe seed kernels of sweet almond, Prunus amygdalus var. dulcis.
prunus-amygdalus-dulcis-sweet-almond-oil.distinctIngredients: Keep this oil separate from almond extracts, proteins, meal and bitter-almond fragrance preparations.

sources.label: Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil — INKEEDecoder

sclerocarya-birrea-seed-oil.name: Sclerocarya Birrea Seed Oil
sclerocarya-birrea-seed-oil.summary: Softens skin with a rich seed oil.
sclerocarya-birrea-seed-oil.body: Marula seed oil helps skin feel smooth and moisturized. It is an oily ingredient from the seeds of the marula tree, with a fatty-acid profile rich in oleic acid.
sclerocarya-birrea-seed-oil.aliasNotes: Oil obtained from Sclerocarya birrea seeds/kernels.
sclerocarya-birrea-seed-oil.distinctIngredients: Separate from marula fruit extract and blends of marula oil with other skin softeners.

simmondsia-chinensis-jojoba-seed-oil.name: Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil
simmondsia-chinensis-jojoba-seed-oil.summary: Softens skin and helps hold in moisture.
simmondsia-chinensis-jojoba-seed-oil.body: Jojoba seed oil helps skin feel smooth and forms a light, moisture-retaining layer. Although called an oil, it is mainly made of liquid wax components rather than the fats typical of most plant oils.
simmondsia-chinensis-jojoba-seed-oil.aliasNotes: Seed-derived liquid wax from Simmondsia chinensis.
simmondsia-chinensis-jojoba-seed-oil.distinctIngredients: Separate from Jojoba Esters, hydrogenated jojoba oil and jojoba/macadamia esters.

squalene.name: Squalene
squalene.summary: Adds an oily ingredient that softens skin.
squalene.body: Squalene is an oily substance also found naturally in the oil on skin’s surface. In cosmetics, it helps skin feel softer and smoother.
squalene.amountAndUse: Squalene reacts with oxygen more readily than squalane, so these two similar-looking names describe different ingredients.
squalene.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from squalane, its hydrogenated form.

stearic-acid.name: Stearic Acid
stearic-acid.summary: Softens skin and gives creams more body.
stearic-acid.body: Stearic acid is a fatty acid that helps skin feel smooth. It also thickens creamy products and helps their oil and water parts stay mixed.
stearic-acid.aliasNotes: Stearic acid is a fatty acid.
stearic-acid.distinctIngredients: Separate from stearyl alcohol and from stearate salts or esters.

stearyl-behenate.name: Stearyl Behenate
stearyl-behenate.summary: Helps make skin feel soft and smooth.
stearyl-behenate.body: Stearyl behenate is a skin-softening ingredient made by joining a fatty alcohol with a fatty acid. It contributes to the smooth feel of a skin-care formula.
stearyl-behenate.aliasNotes: Ester of stearyl alcohol and behenic acid; octadecyl docosanoate.
stearyl-behenate.distinctIngredients: Separate from behenic acid and from the cetearyl-behenate mixture.

tetradecane.name: Tetradecane
tetradecane.summary: Helps products spread with a light feel.
tetradecane.body: Tetradecane is a lightweight liquid used to help cosmetic formulas glide over skin. Cosmetic grades can serve as skin softeners and solvents, helping other oily ingredients blend into the product.
tetradecane.aliasNotes: Straight-chain hydrocarbon with 14 carbon atoms; CAS 629-59-4.
tetradecane.distinctIngredients: Separate from isohexadecane, C13-15 Alkane and silicone oils.

triethylhexanoin.name: Triethylhexanoin
triethylhexanoin.summary: Softens skin and gives products smooth glide.
triethylhexanoin.body: Triethylhexanoin is a liquid skin-softening ingredient that helps products spread evenly. It gives a smooth finish with less sticky or greasy feel and helps retain moisture.
triethylhexanoin.distinctIngredients: Separate from ethylhexyl palmitate and from caprylic/capric triglyceride.

trihydroxystearin.name: Trihydroxystearin
trihydroxystearin.summary: Thickens oils into a more structured texture.
trihydroxystearin.body: Trihydroxystearin helps thicken the oily part of a formula. It can turn a fluid oil mixture into a more gel-like texture, helping give balms and creams their body.
trihydroxystearin.aliasNotes: Hydrogenated castor-oil derivative; glycerol triester of 12-hydroxystearic acid.
trihydroxystearin.distinctIngredients: Separate from unmodified castor seed oil.

acetyl-dipeptide-31-amide.name: Acetyl Dipeptide-31 Amide
acetyl-dipeptide-31-amide.summary: A small peptide used to condition skin.
acetyl-dipeptide-31-amide.body: Acetyl Dipeptide-31 Amide is a small, manufactured peptide used to help keep skin in good condition. Its name identifies a particular modified two-part amino-acid ingredient.
acetyl-dipeptide-31-amide.aliasNotes: An acetylated dipeptide with an amide at one end.

sources.label: ACETYL DIPEPTIDE-31 AMIDE – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

acetyl-hexapeptide-8.name: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8
acetyl-hexapeptide-8.summary: A peptide that helps skin hold water.
acetyl-hexapeptide-8.body: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 is a six-part peptide used to condition skin and help it hold moisture. It is also featured in products aimed at the appearance of expression lines.
acetyl-hexapeptide-8.detail: Claims that a cream works like an injectable treatment go beyond what its ingredient name can tell you.
acetyl-hexapeptide-8.aliasNotes: A specific synthetic peptide, rather than the whole peptide family.

acetyl-tetrapeptide-2.name: Acetyl Tetrapeptide-2
acetyl-tetrapeptide-2.summary: A short peptide used to condition skin.
acetyl-tetrapeptide-2.body: Acetyl Tetrapeptide-2 is a modified chain of four amino-acid building blocks used in skin care. Its documented cosmetic job is skin conditioning, supporting the feel and appearance of the skin.

acetylarginyltryptophyl-diphenylglycine.name: Acetylarginyltryptophyl Diphenylglycine
acetylarginyltryptophyl-diphenylglycine.summary: A modified peptide used to condition skin.
acetylarginyltryptophyl-diphenylglycine.body: Acetylarginyltryptophyl Diphenylglycine is a manufactured peptide ingredient used in skin-conditioning formulas. It appears in products marketed for firmer-looking skin, but that purpose alone does not establish a lifting effect.
acetylarginyltryptophyl-diphenylglycine.evidence: Results from a tested peptide blend cannot be assigned to this ingredient by itself.
acetylarginyltryptophyl-diphenylglycine.aliasNotes: Specific reaction product involving acetic acid, arginine, phenylglycine and tryptophan.

alpha-arbutin.name: Alpha-Arbutin
alpha-arbutin.summary: Used in formulas for more even-looking tone.
alpha-arbutin.body: Alpha-Arbutin is used in skin care aimed at uneven-looking skin tone. It is a specific form of arbutin, so the alpha part of the name matters when comparing ingredient lists.
alpha-arbutin.detail: It is not an exfoliating acid. Much of the mechanistic evidence discussed in this reference comes from laboratory models.
alpha-arbutin.aliasNotes: The alpha form of arbutin; CAS 84380-01-8.
alpha-arbutin.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from beta-arbutin and hydroquinone.

ascorbyl-glucoside.name: Ascorbyl Glucoside
ascorbyl-glucoside.summary: A vitamin C derivative used as an antioxidant.
ascorbyl-glucoside.body: Ascorbyl Glucoside is vitamin C joined to a glucose unit. It is used as an antioxidant, helping limit unwanted reactions involving unstable molecules called free radicals.
ascorbyl-glucoside.detail: Its stability and conversion in skin differ from those of pure ascorbic acid, so the two names are not interchangeable.
ascorbyl-glucoside.distinctIngredients: Not ascorbic acid, sodium ascorbyl phosphate or an oil-soluble vitamin C ester.

avobenzone.name: Avobenzone
avobenzone.summary: Helps sunscreen absorb ultraviolet A light.
avobenzone.body: Avobenzone is a sunscreen ingredient that absorbs UVA, one part of the sun's ultraviolet light. It is usually combined with other filters to build a finished sunscreen's overall protection.
avobenzone.detail: The formula also needs to manage this filter's stability in light.
avobenzone.amountAndUse: Choose and use sunscreen by its tested SPF, broad-spectrum label and directions; this ingredient alone does not specify those results.
avobenzone.aliasNotes: Avobenzone is the name for Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane.

sources.label: Labeling and Effectiveness Testing: Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-The-Counter Human Use

bakuchiol.name: Bakuchiol
bakuchiol.summary: An antioxidant used in skin-care formulas.
bakuchiol.body: Bakuchiol is a plant-associated compound used to condition skin and act as an antioxidant, helping limit reactions involving unstable molecules called free radicals. It belongs to a different chemical family from retinol.
bakuchiol.detail: A bottle labeled with bakuchiol is not a retinoid product solely because of that ingredient.
bakuchiol.aliasNotes: A defined molecule that can be obtained from Psoralea corylifolia; not the whole plant extract.
bakuchiol.distinctIngredients: Not retinol or another vitamin A derivative.

bemotrizinol.name: Bemotrizinol
bemotrizinol.summary: Helps sunscreen absorb UVA and UVB light.
bemotrizinol.body: Bemotrizinol is a UV filter that absorbs both UVA and UVB light. It is used as one part of a sunscreen formula and is relatively stable when exposed to light.
bemotrizinol.amountAndUse: An ingredient's absorption range does not establish a finished sunscreen's SPF or broad-spectrum performance; those require product testing.
bemotrizinol.distinctIngredients: Different from the filter known as Tinosorb M.

sources.label: Labeling and Effectiveness Testing: Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-The-Counter Human Use

benzoyl-peroxide.name: Benzoyl Peroxide
benzoyl-peroxide.summary: Treats acne by reducing acne-associated bacteria.
benzoyl-peroxide.body: Benzoyl Peroxide is an acne-treatment ingredient that reduces acne-associated bacteria on the skin. It is available in washes and leave-on products, and is sometimes combined with other acne medicines.
benzoyl-peroxide.evidence: The American Academy of Dermatology describes it as a standard topical acne-treatment option.
benzoyl-peroxide.caution: Can cause dryness, peeling or irritation and may bleach hair and fabrics. Stop use and seek emergency help for breathing difficulty or swelling of the tongue or throat.
benzoyl-peroxide.amountAndUse: Follow the directions for the particular medicine and strength; wash-off and leave-on products have different instructions.
benzoyl-peroxide.aliasNotes: Benzoyl peroxide, also chemically described as dibenzoyl peroxide.

sources.label: Benzoyl peroxide: a medicine to treat acne – NHS

biotin.name: Biotin
biotin.summary: A vitamin used to condition skin and hair.
biotin.body: Biotin is a vitamin used as a skin- and hair-conditioning ingredient. It may also appear on labels under the name Vitamin H.

bisabolol.name: Bisabolol
bisabolol.summary: Helps make irritated-feeling skin more comfortable.
bisabolol.body: Bisabolol is an oily ingredient used to soothe and condition skin. It is one of the compounds associated with chamomile, but the named ingredient is different from a whole chamomile extract.
bisabolol.aliasNotes: Bisabolol is a defined compound; the reference lists several stereochemical forms.
bisabolol.distinctIngredients: Do not merge with Chamomilla Recutita extracts.

caffeine.name: Caffeine
caffeine.summary: An antioxidant used in skin-care formulas.
caffeine.body: Caffeine is used in skin care for its antioxidant activity: helping limit reactions involving unstable molecules called free radicals. It also helps condition skin and is commonly included in eye creams.
caffeine.detail: Seeing caffeine on an ingredient list does not tell you how much a particular eye cream will change puffiness or dark circles.
caffeine.aliasNotes: Caffeine is the molecule, rather than coffee or tea extract.

capryloyl-salicylic-acid.name: Capryloyl Salicylic Acid
capryloyl-salicylic-acid.summary: Used to help loosen surface dead skin cells.
capryloyl-salicylic-acid.body: Capryloyl Salicylic Acid is a modified salicylic-acid ingredient used in exfoliating skin care. Exfoliation helps lift away dead cells from the surface, while the formula determines how noticeable that effect is.
capryloyl-salicylic-acid.aliasNotes: Capryloyl Salicylic Acid is the 5-capryl ketone of salicylic acid (CAS 78418-01-6), as corrected in CIR's final amended assessment. INKEEDecoder's ester/CAS wording was not adopted.
capryloyl-salicylic-acid.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from salicylic acid; its percentage is not a salicylic-acid dose.

sources.label: CAPRYLOYL SALICYLIC ACID – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe
Pigmentclar Brightening Deep Cleanser – La Roche-Posay
Safety Assessment of Capryloyl Salicylic Acid as Used in Cosmetics – Final Amended Report

colloidal-oatmeal.name: Colloidal Oatmeal
colloidal-oatmeal.summary: Finely ground oats that help condition dry skin.
colloidal-oatmeal.body: Colloidal Oatmeal is very finely ground oat material used in soothing skin-care formulas. It helps give dry skin a softer, more comfortable feel and can play several roles depending on the product.
colloidal-oatmeal.aliasNotes: Fine oatmeal from Avena sativa, rather than a generic oat extract or isolated oat protein.
colloidal-oatmeal.distinctIngredients: Do not automatically merge with Avena Sativa Kernel Extract.

copper-palmitoyl-heptapeptide-14.name: Copper Palmitoyl Heptapeptide-14
copper-palmitoyl-heptapeptide-14.summary: A copper-containing peptide used to condition skin.
copper-palmitoyl-heptapeptide-14.body: Copper Palmitoyl Heptapeptide-14 is a copper-containing, fatty-acid-modified peptide used in skin care. It is one component of certain encapsulated ingredient blends, where the surrounding delivery materials also matter.
copper-palmitoyl-heptapeptide-14.detail: A study of a complete encapsulated blend cannot show what this peptide will do in every other formula.
copper-palmitoyl-heptapeptide-14.aliasNotes: Copper salt of the reaction product of palmitic acid and Heptapeptide-14.
copper-palmitoyl-heptapeptide-14.distinctIngredients: Different from Copper Tripeptide-1 and Heptapeptide-15 Palmitate.

copper-tripeptide-1.name: Copper Tripeptide-1
copper-tripeptide-1.summary: A copper-peptide complex used to condition skin.
copper-tripeptide-1.body: Copper Tripeptide-1 combines copper with a short chain of three amino acids. It is used in skin-conditioning products and is often the ingredient meant when a serum highlights GHK-Cu.
copper-tripeptide-1.distinctIngredients: The broader phrase copper peptides includes other ingredients too.

dipeptide-diaminobutyroyl-benzylamide-di.name: Dipeptide Diaminobutyroyl Benzylamide Diacetate
dipeptide-diaminobutyroyl-benzylamide-di.summary: A small peptide ingredient for skin-care formulas.
dipeptide-diaminobutyroyl-benzylamide-di.body: Dipeptide Diaminobutyroyl Benzylamide Diacetate is a small manufactured peptide ingredient used in skin-care products. It is commonly marketed for expression lines, but that marketing does not make a topical cream equivalent to an injected treatment.
dipeptide-diaminobutyroyl-benzylamide-di.aliasNotes: The full INCI name identifies this specific modified peptide ingredient.

dipotassium-glycyrrhizate.name: Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate
dipotassium-glycyrrhizate.summary: A licorice-related salt that helps hold water.
dipotassium-glycyrrhizate.body: Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate is a salt related to a compound in licorice. It helps hold moisture and condition skin, and is also used in formulas intended to feel soothing.
dipotassium-glycyrrhizate.aliasNotes: Dipotassium salt of glycyrrhizic acid, supported by COSMILE's salt-name explanation.
dipotassium-glycyrrhizate.distinctIngredients: Not a whole licorice extract, monoammonium glycyrrhizinate or stearyl glycyrrhetinate.

ectoin.name: Ectoin
ectoin.summary: Helps hold water in moisturizing skin care.
ectoin.body: Ectoin is a small, water-binding molecule used in moisturizing and soothing skin-care formulas. Its ability to associate with water makes hydration a useful starting point for understanding this ingredient.
ectoin.detail: It was first studied as a molecule that helps certain microorganisms cope with stressful environments.

epigallocatechin-gallatyl-glucoside.name: Epigallocatechin Gallatyl Glucoside
epigallocatechin-gallatyl-glucoside.body: Epigallocatechin Gallatyl Glucoside links the tea-related compound EGCG with glucose. It is used to condition skin and as an antioxidant, helping limit unwanted reactions involving unstable molecules called free radicals.
epigallocatechin-gallatyl-glucoside.distinctIngredients: Not plain EGCG or whole green tea extract.

ergothioneine.name: Ergothioneine
ergothioneine.summary: Helps limit oxidation in a cosmetic formula.
ergothioneine.body: Ergothioneine is an antioxidant ingredient that can help limit oxygen-driven deterioration of a formula's components. It contains sulfur, but that does not make it the same ingredient as elemental sulfur used elsewhere in skin care.

ethyl-ascorbic-acid.name: Ethyl Ascorbic Acid
ethyl-ascorbic-acid.summary: A modified vitamin C used in skin care.
ethyl-ascorbic-acid.body: Ethyl Ascorbic Acid is a modified form of vitamin C used in skin care. Its antioxidant role means helping limit unwanted reactions involving unstable molecules called free radicals.
ethyl-ascorbic-acid.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from Ascorbyl Glucoside, Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate and pure Ascorbic Acid.

ferulic-acid.name: Ferulic Acid
ferulic-acid.summary: Helps limit oxidation in skin-care formulas.
ferulic-acid.body: Ferulic Acid is an antioxidant compound also found in plant cell walls. In skin care, it is often paired with other antioxidants rather than used as a surface-exfoliating acid.
ferulic-acid.detail: Some research concerns specific vitamin C, vitamin E and ferulic-acid mixtures, so the blend matters when interpreting a claim.
ferulic-acid.distinctIngredients: Its acid name does not make it interchangeable with glycolic or other exfoliating acids.

gluconolactone.name: Gluconolactone
gluconolactone.summary: Helps loosen dead cells on the skin's surface.
gluconolactone.body: Gluconolactone is used in exfoliating skin care and can also help hold water. It belongs to the group commonly called polyhydroxy acids, or PHAs, and can help leave the surface feeling smoother.
gluconolactone.detail: It also binds metal ions, which can help manage unwanted reactions in a formula.
gluconolactone.distinctIngredients: Not gluconic acid, sodium gluconate or lactobionic acid.

glutathione.name: Glutathione
glutathione.summary: Helps control chemical reactions in a formula.
glutathione.body: Glutathione is a small molecule built from three amino-acid units. In cosmetics it is used as a reducing agent, which helps control chemical reactions within the formula.
glutathione.aliasNotes: Glutathione; CAS 70-18-8; contains glutamate, cysteine and glycine units.
glutathione.distinctIngredients: Not glutathione palmitamide or a fatty-acid-modified glutathione derivative.

heptapeptide-15-palmitate.name: Heptapeptide-15 Palmitate
heptapeptide-15-palmitate.summary: A modified peptide used in conditioning blends.
heptapeptide-15-palmitate.body: Heptapeptide-15 Palmitate is a fatty-acid-linked peptide used in skin-conditioning blends. In the encapsulated system described by the reference, it has a different job from the copper peptide carried inside.
heptapeptide-15-palmitate.aliasNotes: Ester of palmitic acid and Heptapeptide-15.
heptapeptide-15-palmitate.distinctIngredients: Not Copper Palmitoyl Heptapeptide-14; the blend name is not an alias for this ingredient alone.

heptapeptide-6.name: Heptapeptide-6
heptapeptide-6.summary: A seven-part peptide used to condition skin.
heptapeptide-6.body: Heptapeptide-6 is a manufactured chain of seven amino-acid building blocks used to condition skin. It appears in peptide blends, whose other ingredients and delivery format are part of the finished formula.
heptapeptide-6.aliasNotes: A specific synthetic heptapeptide, distinct from other numbered peptides.
heptapeptide-6.distinctIngredients: Do not merge with sh-Heptapeptide-6 SP.

homosalate.name: Homosalate
homosalate.summary: Helps sunscreen absorb ultraviolet B light.
homosalate.body: Homosalate is an oil-soluble UVB filter used with other sunscreen ingredients. It can also help dissolve some solid filters, making it useful both for UV absorption and for building the formula.
homosalate.amountAndUse: Check the finished product's tested SPF and broad-spectrum label.
homosalate.distinctIngredients: Not Octisalate, although both are salicylate-family UV filters.

sources.label: Labeling and Effectiveness Testing: Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-The-Counter Human Use

hydroxymethoxyphenyl-decanone.name: Hydroxymethoxyphenyl Decanone
hydroxymethoxyphenyl-decanone.summary: Used in antioxidant-focused and soothing formulas.
hydroxymethoxyphenyl-decanone.body: Hydroxymethoxyphenyl Decanone is a manufactured compound modeled on a substance found in a plant from the ginger family. It is used as a skin-conditioning ingredient in antioxidant-focused and soothing formulas.
hydroxymethoxyphenyl-decanone.aliasNotes: A defined molecule, described as nature-identical; not a whole ginger extract.

hydroxypinacolone-retinoate.name: Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate
hydroxypinacolone-retinoate.summary: A vitamin A-related ingredient used in skin care.
hydroxypinacolone-retinoate.body: Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate, often shortened to HPR, is a retinoid used in skin-care formulas aimed at texture and lines. It is a different molecule from retinol and prescription tretinoin.
hydroxypinacolone-retinoate.evidence: Results from a retinoid mixture cannot identify HPR's contribution by itself.
hydroxypinacolone-retinoate.caution: AAD guidance advises avoiding retinoid skin care during pregnancy. Retinoids can also irritate skin; follow the product's directions rather than assuming a newer form is irritation-free.
hydroxypinacolone-retinoate.amountAndUse: A percentage advertised for a branded retinoid blend may include its solvent, so it may not be the percentage of HPR itself.
hydroxypinacolone-retinoate.distinctIngredients: Granactive Retinoid can describe a supplied blend, not pure HPR alone; keep separate from retinol and tretinoin.

ichthammol.name: Ichthammol
ichthammol.summary: Used for its activity against microorganisms.
ichthammol.body: Ichthammol is a complex material made from processed shale oil and listed for antimicrobial use in cosmetics. That ingredient-level role does not establish that a cosmetic cream will treat an infection or draw out a splinter.
ichthammol.aliasNotes: Ammonium salt of dark sulfonated shale oil; CAS 8029-68-3.
ichthammol.distinctIngredients: Not coal tar or elemental sulfur.

kojic-acid.name: Kojic Acid
kojic-acid.summary: Used in formulas aimed at uneven-looking tone.
kojic-acid.body: Kojic Acid is used in skin-tone-focused formulas and also has an antioxidant role. Its acid name should not be read as a promise of the same exfoliating action as glycolic or mandelic acid.
kojic-acid.caution: Ask a clinician before using on damaged or freshly peeled skin: a weakened skin barrier can increase absorption.

sources.label: SCCS Opinion on Kojic Acid, SCCS/1637/21, final version and corrigendum

madecassoside.name: Madecassoside
madecassoside.summary: A centella-associated compound used to soothe skin.
madecassoside.body: Madecassoside is one of the compounds found in Centella asiatica. It is used for skin conditioning, soothing and antioxidant support, while remaining a distinct ingredient from the whole plant extract.
madecassoside.distinctIngredients: Not Centella Asiatica Extract, asiaticoside or madecassic acid.

mandelic-acid.name: Mandelic Acid
mandelic-acid.summary: Helps remove dead cells from the skin's surface.
mandelic-acid.body: Mandelic Acid is an alpha hydroxy acid, or AHA, used to exfoliate the skin's surface. Removing accumulated dead cells can help the surface feel smoother, with the strength of that effect depending on the formula.
mandelic-acid.caution: AHA products may increase sun sensitivity. Use sunscreen, protective clothing and limited sun exposure during use and for a week after stopping.
mandelic-acid.amountAndUse: Concentration, acidity and the other ingredients influence exfoliation; a peel study does not describe every daily-use serum.
mandelic-acid.distinctIngredients: Not mandelic-acid salts or a whole almond extract.

octisalate.name: Octisalate
octisalate.summary: Helps sunscreen absorb ultraviolet B light.
octisalate.body: Octisalate is an oily UVB filter that usually works alongside other sunscreen ingredients. It can also help dissolve solid filters, supporting the way a finished sunscreen is put together.
octisalate.amountAndUse: Use the finished product's tested SPF and broad-spectrum label to judge its protection.
octisalate.distinctIngredients: Not salicylic acid used for exfoliation.

sources.label: Labeling and Effectiveness Testing: Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-The-Counter Human Use

octocrylene.name: Octocrylene
octocrylene.summary: Helps sunscreen absorb UVB and some UVA light.
octocrylene.body: Octocrylene is an oil-soluble UV filter used with other sunscreen ingredients. Alongside absorbing mainly UVB and some shorter-wave UVA, it can help stabilize certain other filters in a formula.
octocrylene.caution: If you have had a sunlight-triggered allergy to ketoprofen applied to skin, ask a clinician about products containing octocrylene.
octocrylene.amountAndUse: Its presence does not establish the finished product's SPF or water resistance.

sources.label: Labeling and Effectiveness Testing: Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-The-Counter Human Use
SCCS Opinion on Octocrylene, SCCS/1627/21, final opinion (2021)

palmitoyl-sh-hexapeptide-13-serine-sp-am.name: Palmitoyl sh-Hexapeptide-13 Serine SP Amide
palmitoyl-sh-hexapeptide-13-serine-sp-am.summary: A modified peptide used in skin-care blends.
palmitoyl-sh-hexapeptide-13-serine-sp-am.body: Palmitoyl sh-Hexapeptide-13 Serine SP Amide is a modified peptide included in some multi-ingredient delivery systems. The supplier describes one such blend for moisturizing products; the blend's name and claims do not describe this ingredient alone.
palmitoyl-sh-hexapeptide-13-serine-sp-am.aliasNotes: Preserve the complete sh-, Serine SP and Amide name components.
palmitoyl-sh-hexapeptide-13-serine-sp-am.distinctIngredients: Not Heptapeptide-15 Palmitate; X50 Hyalufiller names a blend rather than an exact ingredient alias.

sources.label: Palmitoyl sh-Hexapeptide-13 Serine SP Amide (with Product List)

palmitoyl-tetrapeptide-7.name: Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7
palmitoyl-tetrapeptide-7.summary: A fatty-acid-linked peptide used to condition skin.
palmitoyl-tetrapeptide-7.body: Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7 is a four-part peptide attached to a fatty-acid group. It is used to condition skin and is often paired with Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 in cosmetic peptide blends.
palmitoyl-tetrapeptide-7.distinctIngredients: Matrixyl 3000 is a multi-ingredient blend, not this ingredient alone.

palmitoyl-tripeptide-1.name: Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1
palmitoyl-tripeptide-1.summary: A fatty-acid-linked peptide used to condition skin.
palmitoyl-tripeptide-1.body: Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 combines a three-amino-acid chain with a fatty-acid group. It is used in skin-conditioning formulas, including blends that also contain Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7.
palmitoyl-tripeptide-1.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from Copper Tripeptide-1. The older broad name Palmitoyl Oligopeptide is not recorded here as an unqualified exact alias.

palmitoyl-tripeptide-38.name: Palmitoyl Tripeptide-38
palmitoyl-tripeptide-38.summary: A modified three-part peptide used to condition skin.
palmitoyl-tripeptide-38.body: Palmitoyl Tripeptide-38 is a short peptide linked to a fatty-acid group. It is used in skin-conditioning formulas and is one of several distinct peptides found in products aimed at the appearance of lines.
palmitoyl-tripeptide-38.aliasNotes: Reaction product of palmitic acid and Tripeptide-38.
palmitoyl-tripeptide-38.distinctIngredients: Different from Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1; the number identifies a different peptide.

panthenyl-triacetate.name: Panthenyl Triacetate
panthenyl-triacetate.summary: A panthenol derivative used for conditioning.
panthenyl-triacetate.body: Panthenyl Triacetate is a modified form of panthenol. Its documented cosmetic roles include hair conditioning and reducing static, which can help hair feel softer and easier to manage.
panthenyl-triacetate.aliasNotes: Triacetate derivative containing panthenol as the alcohol component.
panthenyl-triacetate.distinctIngredients: Not Panthenol; benefits from plain panthenol should not automatically be assigned to this derivative.

pentapeptide-18.name: Pentapeptide-18
pentapeptide-18.summary: A five-part peptide used to condition skin.
pentapeptide-18.body: Pentapeptide-18 is a manufactured chain of five amino-acid building blocks used in skin care. It is included in some expression-line-focused blends, where other peptides may contribute to the formula's intended effect.
pentapeptide-18.aliasNotes: Specific synthetic pentapeptide containing alanine, glycine, leucine, phenylalanine and tyrosine.
pentapeptide-18.distinctIngredients: Not Acetyl Hexapeptide-8; a blend containing both is not a synonym for either.

pyridoxine-hcl.name: Pyridoxine HCl
pyridoxine-hcl.summary: A vitamin B6 form used to condition skin.
pyridoxine-hcl.body: Pyridoxine HCl is a salt form of vitamin B6 used in skin- and hair-conditioning formulas. HCl stands for hydrochloride and identifies the particular form used.
pyridoxine-hcl.distinctIngredients: Not all forms of vitamin B6 share this INCI name.

resveratrol.name: Resveratrol
resveratrol.summary: A plant-associated antioxidant used in skin care.
resveratrol.body: Resveratrol is an antioxidant compound found in plants, including grapes. Antioxidants help limit unwanted reactions involving unstable molecules called free radicals.
resveratrol.aliasNotes: A specific resveratrol molecule, distinct from grape seed or grape skin extract.

sh-oligopeptide-1.name: sh-Oligopeptide-1
sh-oligopeptide-1.summary: A manufactured protein used in skin-conditioning formulas.
sh-oligopeptide-1.body: sh-Oligopeptide-1 is a manufactured protein modeled on epidermal growth factor, often called EGF. It is used in skin-conditioning formulas; growth factor describes the protein's biological identity, rather than a guaranteed visible result from a cream.
sh-oligopeptide-1.detail: The source describes production by fermentation using a copied human gene, rather than extraction from human tissue.
sh-oligopeptide-1.aliasNotes: The specific recombinant EGF-type ingredient described by this INCI name.
sh-oligopeptide-1.distinctIngredients: Not sh-Oligopeptide-2, a whole conditioned medium or every material marketed as EGF.

sh-oligopeptide-2.name: sh-Oligopeptide-2
sh-oligopeptide-2.summary: A growth-factor-type protein used to condition skin.
sh-oligopeptide-2.body: sh-Oligopeptide-2 is a manufactured version of an insulin-like growth-factor protein used in skin care. It is a skin-conditioning ingredient, and the specific protein name helps distinguish it from the other growth factors in a blend.
sh-oligopeptide-2.aliasNotes: Recombinant peptide described as based on insulin-like growth factor 1.
sh-oligopeptide-2.distinctIngredients: Not insulin, sh-Oligopeptide-1 or the entire growth-factor blend.

sh-polypeptide-1.name: sh-Polypeptide-1
sh-polypeptide-1.summary: A manufactured protein used to condition skin.
sh-polypeptide-1.body: sh-Polypeptide-1 is a manufactured protein modeled on basic fibroblast growth factor. It is used in skin-conditioning formulas, often alongside other proteins whose similar-looking names identify different ingredients.
sh-polypeptide-1.aliasNotes: Recombinant basic-fibroblast-growth-factor-type protein produced by fermentation.
sh-polypeptide-1.distinctIngredients: Different from acidic fibroblast growth factor-related sh-Polypeptide-11.

sh-polypeptide-11.name: sh-Polypeptide-11
sh-polypeptide-11.summary: A growth-factor-type protein used in skin care.
sh-polypeptide-11.body: sh-Polypeptide-11 is a manufactured protein modeled on acidic fibroblast growth factor. It appears in growth-factor-focused skin care, where the formula's ability to deliver a protein is important to interpreting any claimed benefit.
sh-polypeptide-11.aliasNotes: Recombinant acidic fibroblast growth factor 1-type protein described by the INCI name.
sh-polypeptide-11.distinctIngredients: Not sh-Polypeptide-1, which refers to a different fibroblast growth factor.

sh-polypeptide-9.name: sh-Polypeptide-9
sh-polypeptide-9.summary: A manufactured protein used to condition skin.
sh-polypeptide-9.body: sh-Polypeptide-9 is a manufactured protein based on a vascular endothelial growth factor. It is used in skin-conditioning blends; the growth-factor label identifies the type of protein without proving a rejuvenating effect from the finished product.
sh-polypeptide-9.aliasNotes: Recombinant VEGF-A-type protein produced by fermentation.
sh-polypeptide-9.distinctIngredients: BIO-Placenta is a blend name, not a synonym for this peptide alone or proof of placental sourcing.

sodium-ascorbyl-phosphate.name: Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate
sodium-ascorbyl-phosphate.summary: A water-compatible vitamin C derivative for formulas.
sodium-ascorbyl-phosphate.body: Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate is a vitamin C derivative used as an antioxidant, helping limit reactions involving unstable molecules called free radicals. Its phosphate and sodium parts change how it behaves in a formula.
sodium-ascorbyl-phosphate.detail: Different vitamin C derivatives have different absorption and conversion evidence; matching label percentages does not establish matching skin effects.
sodium-ascorbyl-phosphate.distinctIngredients: Not Sodium Ascorbate or Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate.

stearyl-glycyrrhetinate.name: Stearyl Glycyrrhetinate
stearyl-glycyrrhetinate.summary: A modified licorice-related compound that soothes skin.
stearyl-glycyrrhetinate.body: Stearyl Glycyrrhetinate is a skin-conditioning and soothing ingredient related to glycyrrhetinic acid. It can help reduce feelings of skin discomfort, while its modified form makes it distinct from a whole licorice extract.
stearyl-glycyrrhetinate.aliasNotes: Stearyl-alcohol ester of glycyrrhetinic acid; CAS 13832-70-7.
stearyl-glycyrrhetinate.distinctIngredients: Not Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate or Glycyrrhetinic Acid itself.

sulfur.name: Sulfur
sulfur.summary: An element used in conditioning and acne formulas.
sulfur.body: Sulfur is an element used in some acne medicines, and it also has cosmetic skin-conditioning roles. Its presence in a cosmetic cream alone does not tell you that the product is an acne medicine.
sulfur.caution: The reviewed 10% sulfur medicine warns of dryness and irritation, especially with other acne treatments. Follow the specific product's label, including when to stop using it.
sulfur.amountAndUse: The source drug label is for a 10% rinse-off ointment; its directions are not instructions for every sulfur-containing cosmetic.
sulfur.distinctIngredients: Not sodium sulfacetamide, sulfate salts, sulfites or other sulfur-containing compounds.

tartaric-acid.name: Tartaric Acid
tartaric-acid.summary: Helps control the acidity of a cosmetic formula.
tartaric-acid.body: Tartaric Acid helps control a product's acidity, also called its pH. It can appear in exfoliating formulas too, but a small amount used to balance acidity does not make every product a peel.
tartaric-acid.amountAndUse: The overall acid blend, amount and finished pH matter more than the word acid alone.
tartaric-acid.aliasNotes: 2,3-dihydroxybutanedioic acid; the registry encompasses more than one stereochemical form.
tartaric-acid.distinctIngredients: Not tartaric-acid salts such as potassium bitartrate.

tetrahexyldecyl-ascorbate.name: Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate
tetrahexyldecyl-ascorbate.summary: An oil-soluble vitamin C derivative for skin care.
tetrahexyldecyl-ascorbate.body: Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate is a vitamin C derivative that mixes with oils. It is used as an antioxidant, helping limit unwanted reactions involving unstable molecules called free radicals.
tetrahexyldecyl-ascorbate.detail: Its skin benefits depend on the formula and on what reaches the skin in an active form; oil solubility alone is not a measure of effectiveness.
tetrahexyldecyl-ascorbate.distinctIngredients: Not pure Ascorbic Acid; do not automatically merge with other ascorbyl esters.

titanium-dioxide.name: Titanium Dioxide
titanium-dioxide.summary: Filters UV light or adds whiteness to formulas.
titanium-dioxide.body: Titanium Dioxide can be a mineral UV filter, a white pigment or an ingredient that makes a product look opaque. Its job depends on the grade and the finished formula, so presence alone does not mean sunscreen protection.
titanium-dioxide.detail: Particle size and surface treatment can affect the product's appearance and feel.
titanium-dioxide.amountAndUse: Sunscreen protection comes from the tested finished product and its labeled directions.
titanium-dioxide.aliasNotes: Titanium dioxide; the color-index designation shown is CI 77891.
titanium-dioxide.distinctIngredients: Keep sunscreen and colorant uses distinct; nano status cannot be inferred from this base name alone.

sources.label: Labeling and Effectiveness Testing: Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-The-Counter Human Use

tocopherol.name: Tocopherol
tocopherol.summary: A vitamin E ingredient that helps limit oxidation.
tocopherol.body: Tocopherol is a fat-soluble vitamin E ingredient used as an antioxidant and skin conditioner. In a formula it can help slow oxidation, including deterioration of ingredients that contain oils.
tocopherol.detail: The name can cover more than one tocopherol type, so it does not always mean a single purified form.
tocopherol.aliasNotes: The INCI name can encompass alpha-, beta-, gamma- and/or delta-tocopherol.

tocopheryl-acetate.name: Tocopheryl Acetate
tocopheryl-acetate.summary: A vitamin E derivative used to condition skin.
tocopheryl-acetate.body: Tocopheryl Acetate is a modified form of vitamin E used in skin-conditioning formulas. The acetate group makes it a different ingredient from tocopherol, with different stability and behavior in a product.

tocotrienols.name: Tocotrienols
tocotrienols.summary: Vitamin E-family ingredients used to condition skin.
tocotrienols.body: Tocotrienols are members of the vitamin E family used in skin-conditioning formulas. They belong to a different branch of that family from tocopherols, so their names should stay separate when comparing ingredient lists.
tocotrienols.aliasNotes: Tocotrienols refers to the tocotrienol forms of vitamin E.

sources.label: Vitamin E – Health Professional Fact Sheet

tranexamic-acid.name: Tranexamic Acid
tranexamic-acid.summary: Used in topical care for uneven-looking pigmentation.
tranexamic-acid.body: Tranexamic Acid is used in topical formulas aimed at uneven-looking pigmentation. Although acid is part of its name, it is not usually included to peel away surface cells like an AHA exfoliant.
tranexamic-acid.detail: A 12-week melasma trial analyzing 100 adults found improved pigmentation scores with a 5% topical solution used daily alongside sunscreen.
tranexamic-acid.evidence: The trial lacked a base-formula-only comparison and used different product types in its two groups. These limits matter when applying its findings to other serums.
tranexamic-acid.caution: Some participants in that trial reported skin irritation. Persistent or changing pigmentation is worth discussing with a dermatologist.
tranexamic-acid.distinctIngredients: This card concerns topical skin care; it is not guidance for oral or injected tranexamic-acid medicines.

sources.label: A Randomized Controlled Study Comparing the Efficacy of Topical 5% Tranexamic Acid Solution versus 3% Hydroquinone Cream in Melasma

zinc-gluconate.name: Zinc Gluconate
zinc-gluconate.summary: A zinc salt used to condition skin.
zinc-gluconate.body: Zinc Gluconate is a zinc salt with skin-conditioning and deodorizing uses in cosmetics. It is different from zinc oxide, so a product containing it should not be assumed to work as a mineral sunscreen.
zinc-gluconate.aliasNotes: Zinc salt of gluconic acid; CAS 4468-02-4.
zinc-gluconate.distinctIngredients: Not Zinc Oxide or Zinc PCA.

zinc-oxide.name: Zinc Oxide
zinc-oxide.summary: A mineral ingredient with several skin-care uses.
zinc-oxide.body: Zinc Oxide can serve as a mineral UV filter, a white pigment and a skin-protecting ingredient. In sunscreen it helps absorb UVA and UVB, but a cream's protection still depends on the finished formula.
zinc-oxide.amountAndUse: Look for the tested SPF and broad-spectrum labeling rather than inferring protection from its presence.
zinc-oxide.distinctIngredients: Not Zinc Gluconate or Zinc PCA; the base name alone does not state particle size.

sources.label: Labeling and Effectiveness Testing: Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-The-Counter Human Use

zinc-pca.name: Zinc PCA
zinc-pca.summary: A zinc salt that helps hold moisture.
zinc-pca.body: Zinc PCA is a zinc salt of pyrrolidone carboxylic acid, a moisture-related compound. It is used to help hold water and condition skin, including in formulas designed for an oily-skin routine.
zinc-pca.aliasNotes: Zinc salt of PCA, or pyrrolidone carboxylic acid.
zinc-pca.distinctIngredients: Not Zinc Gluconate, Zinc Oxide or Sodium PCA.

acetyl-rheum-rhaponticum-root-extract.name: Acetyl Rheum Rhaponticum Root Extract
acetyl-rheum-rhaponticum-root-extract.summary: Modified rhubarb root extract used in brightening formulas
acetyl-rheum-rhaponticum-root-extract.body: This ingredient starts with rhubarb root extract and is chemically modified through a process called acetylation. Its documented cosmetic role is skin brightening, so it may be included in formulas intended for more even-looking tone.
acetyl-rheum-rhaponticum-root-extract.evidence: The sources establish its intended cosmetic job, rather than the size or speed of a visible result.
acetyl-rheum-rhaponticum-root-extract.aliasNotes: Rheum rhaponticum root extract reacted with acetic anhydride; the acetylated derivative is preserved.
acetyl-rheum-rhaponticum-root-extract.distinctIngredients: Do not merge with untreated Rheum Rhaponticum Root Extract.

sources.label: Acetyl Rheum Rhaponticum Root Extract (with Product List)
ACETYL RHEUM RHAPONTICUM ROOT EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice.name: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice.summary: Leaf juice that helps skin hold water
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice.body: Aloe leaf juice is used to add moisture and help skin feel comfortable. It is the liquid expressed from Aloe barbadensis leaves, rather than an oil or a dry plant powder.
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice.aliasNotes: Juice expressed from Aloe barbadensis leaves.
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from leaf water, dried leaf juice powder and leaf extract.

aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice-powder.name: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice Powder
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice-powder.summary: Dried aloe juice for moisture and softness
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice-powder.body: This powder is aloe leaf juice with most of its water removed. It can be used in a formula to help moisturize skin and leave it feeling softer.
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice-powder.amountAndUse: Drying changes the concentration of the raw material, so powder and juice percentages are not directly comparable.
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice-powder.aliasNotes: Dried juice from Aloe barbadensis leaves; not powdered whole leaves.
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice-powder.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Powder and liquid Leaf Juice.

sources.label: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice Powder (Explained + Products)

aloe-barbadensis-leaf-water.name: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Water
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-water.summary: Distilled aloe leaf water that adjusts scent
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-water.body: Aloe leaf water is made by steam-distilling the leaves. Its documented cosmetic role is to help adjust a product’s smell, rather than supplying the same material as expressed aloe juice.
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-water.aliasNotes: Aqueous steam distillate of Aloe barbadensis leaves.
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-water.distinctIngredients: Different preparation from expressed leaf juice and dried juice powder.

sources.label: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Water (with Product List)
ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF WATER – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

ananas-sativus-pineapple-fruit-extract.name: Ananas Sativus (Pineapple) Fruit Extract
ananas-sativus-pineapple-fruit-extract.summary: Pineapple fruit extract that supports moisture
ananas-sativus-pineapple-fruit-extract.body: This pineapple fruit extract is used to help moisturize and condition skin. Its water-binding sugars and amino acids can contribute to a softer, more comfortable feel.
ananas-sativus-pineapple-fruit-extract.aliasNotes: Extract of Ananas sativus fruit; pineapple in parentheses is the common plant name.

arctium-lappa-root-extract.name: Arctium Lappa Root Extract
arctium-lappa-root-extract.summary: Burdock root extract with antioxidant components
arctium-lappa-root-extract.body: Burdock root extract is a botanical ingredient used to condition skin. It also contributes antioxidant compounds, which can help limit oxidation, a chemical reaction that can change other substances.
arctium-lappa-root-extract.aliasNotes: Root extract of Arctium lappa, rather than leaf or seed material.

avena-sativa-oat-kernel-extract.name: Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract
avena-sativa-oat-kernel-extract.summary: Oat kernel extract that helps soften skin
avena-sativa-oat-kernel-extract.body: This extract from oat kernels helps soften and condition skin. It is a plant extract used for skin feel, with composition that depends on how the oats are processed.
avena-sativa-oat-kernel-extract.aliasNotes: Extract from kernels of Avena sativa.
avena-sativa-oat-kernel-extract.distinctIngredients: Do not treat kernel extract as interchangeable with finely ground colloidal oatmeal or oat kernel oil.

bidens-pilosa-extract.name: Bidens Pilosa Extract
bidens-pilosa-extract.summary: Plant extract that helps hold onto water
bidens-pilosa-extract.body: Bidens pilosa extract helps retain moisture in a formula and conditions the skin. A humectant is simply a water-holding ingredient, one of the ways a product can support a comfortable skin feel.
bidens-pilosa-extract.aliasNotes: Extract of the Bidens pilosa herb; no specific plant part is added to the name.

sources.label: BIDENS PILOSA EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

bixa-orellana-seed-extract.name: Bixa Orellana Seed Extract
bixa-orellana-seed-extract.summary: Seed extract that conditions skin and adjusts scent
bixa-orellana-seed-extract.body: This extract from Bixa orellana seeds is used to condition skin and help adjust a product’s smell. The name specifies the seed extract, so it should be read separately from oil made from the same plant.
bixa-orellana-seed-extract.aliasNotes: Bixa orellana seed extract; INCI identifies the plant as annatto.
bixa-orellana-seed-extract.distinctIngredients: Separate from Bixa Orellana Seed Oil.

sources.label: Bixa Orellana Seed Extract (with Product List)
BIXA ORELLANA SEED EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

camellia-sinensis-leaf-extract.name: Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract
camellia-sinensis-leaf-extract.summary: Tea-leaf extract that supplies antioxidant compounds
camellia-sinensis-leaf-extract.body: Tea-leaf extract contributes antioxidants called polyphenols. These compounds help limit oxidation, and the extract also has a skin-conditioning role in cosmetic formulas.
camellia-sinensis-leaf-extract.detail: Catechins are one group of tea polyphenols; EGCG is a well-known example. Extracts can differ substantially in how much of these compounds they contain.
camellia-sinensis-leaf-extract.amountAndUse: The ingredient name does not specify the amount of catechins in the extract.
camellia-sinensis-leaf-extract.aliasNotes: Extract of Camellia sinensis leaves, not tea seed oil.

carica-papaya-papaya-fruit-extract.name: Carica Papaya (Papaya) Fruit Extract
carica-papaya-papaya-fruit-extract.summary: Papaya fruit extract used to condition skin
carica-papaya-papaya-fruit-extract.body: Papaya fruit extract is a botanical ingredient used to help keep skin in good condition. It comes from the fruit pulp, with the extraction process determining which components enter the formula.
carica-papaya-papaya-fruit-extract.aliasNotes: Extract of Carica papaya fruit pulp.
carica-papaya-papaya-fruit-extract.distinctIngredients: Not interchangeable with the isolated enzyme papain or with papaya seed oil.

sources.label: Carica Papaya Fruit Extract (with Product List)
CARICA PAPAYA FRUIT EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

cassia-alata-leaf-extract.name: Cassia Alata Leaf Extract
cassia-alata-leaf-extract.summary: Leaf extract that gives a tightening skin feel
cassia-alata-leaf-extract.body: This extract comes from Cassia alata leaves. Its cosmetic role is astringent: it can give skin a temporarily tighter feeling, a sensory effect distinct from long-term firming.
cassia-alata-leaf-extract.aliasNotes: Leaf extract of Cassia alata, described as candle tree / senna.

centella-asiatica-leaf-extract.name: Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract
centella-asiatica-leaf-extract.summary: Centella leaf extract that helps condition skin
centella-asiatica-leaf-extract.body: This extract is made from the leaves of Centella asiatica, a plant also known as gotu kola. It is used to condition skin and can be part of formulas designed for a comfortable, moisturized feel.
centella-asiatica-leaf-extract.aliasNotes: Centella asiatica leaf extract; leaf preparation is preserved.
centella-asiatica-leaf-extract.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from Centella Asiatica Extract, leaf water, cell-culture extracts and isolated madecassoside.

sources.label: Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract (with Product List)

chondrus-crispus-extract.name: Chondrus Crispus Extract
chondrus-crispus-extract.summary: Seaweed extract for moisture and smooth texture
chondrus-crispus-extract.body: This red-seaweed extract helps a product feel smooth and can help hold moisture near the skin’s surface. It can also change how thick or gel-like the formula feels.
chondrus-crispus-extract.detail: Its film-forming action means it can leave a thin, flexible layer at the surface.
chondrus-crispus-extract.aliasNotes: Extract from the red alga Chondrus crispus.
chondrus-crispus-extract.distinctIngredients: Do not merge all seaweed extracts or purified carrageenan under this exact identity.

chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-extrac.name: Chrysanthemum Parthenium (Feverfew) Extract
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-extrac.summary: Feverfew herb extract used to condition skin
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-extrac.body: Feverfew extract is used in cosmetics to help keep skin in good condition. This name refers to an extract of the herb, rather than specifically to its flowers or an essential oil.
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-extrac.caution: Feverfew’s parthenolide can trigger an allergic skin rash in some people. This ingredient name does not tell you whether that component was removed.
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-extrac.aliasNotes: Chrysanthemum parthenium herb extract; COSMILE also identifies the plant as Tanacetum parthenium.
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-extrac.distinctIngredients: Do not merge with Chrysanthemum Parthenium Flower Extract.

sources.label: CHRYSANTHEMUM PARTHENIUM EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-flower.name: Chrysanthemum Parthenium (Feverfew) Flower/Leaf/Stem Juice
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-flower.summary: Helps protect ingredients from oxygen-related deterioration.
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-flower.body: This is juice from feverfew flowers, leaves and stems, used for skin conditioning and as an antioxidant. In a formula, an antioxidant helps limit changes caused by reactions with oxygen.
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-flower.detail: The plant parts and juice form matter. Results for a different feverfew extract should not automatically be applied to this ingredient.
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-flower.caution: Feverfew can cause contact allergy because of parthenolide. This ingredient name does not establish that parthenolide was removed; avoid it if you have a known feverfew or parthenolide contact allergy.
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-flower.aliasNotes: Juice expressed from feverfew flowers, leaves and stems; exact botanical parts and preparation retained.
chrysanthemum-parthenium-feverfew-flower.distinctIngredients: Not a blanket alias for feverfew extract, parthenolide-free extract or isolated feverfew constituents.

sources.label: Defined Organism Substance — Chrysanthemum Parthenium (Feverfew) Flower/Leaf/Stem Juice
CHRYSANTHEMUM PARTHENIUM FLOWER/LEAF/STEM JUICE — COSMILE Europe

citrus-limon-lemon-fruit-extract.name: Citrus Limon (Lemon) Fruit Extract
citrus-limon-lemon-fruit-extract.summary: Lemon fruit extract for skin feel and scent
citrus-limon-lemon-fruit-extract.body: Lemon fruit extract helps condition skin and can adjust the smell of a formula. It is a mixture of fruit-derived components, rather than a measured dose of pure citric acid.
citrus-limon-lemon-fruit-extract.distinctIngredients: Separate from lemon peel oil, lemon juice and isolated citric acid.

coffea-arabica-coffee-seed-extract.name: Coffea Arabica (Coffee) Seed Extract
coffea-arabica-coffee-seed-extract.summary: Coffee-bean extract that conditions skin and adjusts scent
coffea-arabica-coffee-seed-extract.body: This extract from coffee beans is used to condition skin and help shape a product’s scent. The ingredient name identifies a plant extract, rather than pure caffeine.
coffea-arabica-coffee-seed-extract.aliasNotes: Extract of Coffea arabica beans, which are the plant’s seeds.
coffea-arabica-coffee-seed-extract.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from coffee seed oil, coffee grounds and isolated caffeine.

sources.label: Coffea Arabica Seed Extract (with Product List)
COFFEA ARABICA SEED EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

cucumis-sativus-cucumber-fruit-extract.name: Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract
cucumis-sativus-cucumber-fruit-extract.summary: Cucumber fruit extract that helps soften skin
cucumis-sativus-cucumber-fruit-extract.body: Cucumber fruit extract helps soften and condition skin. This botanical ingredient supports how a formula feels on skin, and comes from the fruit rather than the seed oil.

daucus-carota-sativa-extract.name: Daucus Carota Sativa Extract
daucus-carota-sativa-extract.summary: Carrot extract that conditions skin and adds scent
daucus-carota-sativa-extract.body: This carrot extract is used to condition skin and contribute to a formula’s smell. Its name refers to a plant extract, so it should be kept separate from carrot seed oil.
daucus-carota-sativa-extract.aliasNotes: Extract of the whole carrot, Daucus carota subsp. sativus, per INCI description.
daucus-carota-sativa-extract.distinctIngredients: Not carrot seed oil, carrot root-only extract or retinol.

sources.label: Daucus Carota Sativa Extract (with Product List)
DAUCUS CAROTA SATIVA EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

eucalyptus-globulus-leaf-oil.name: Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Oil
eucalyptus-globulus-leaf-oil.summary: Aromatic leaf oil that adds eucalyptus scent
eucalyptus-globulus-leaf-oil.body: Eucalyptus leaf oil gives a product its distinctive, camphor-like smell. It is an essential oil obtained by steam distillation of the leaves and used as a fragrance ingredient.
eucalyptus-globulus-leaf-oil.caution: Essential oils can trigger allergic skin reactions and, at high concentrations, irritation. Avoid eucalyptus oil if you have a known allergy to it.
eucalyptus-globulus-leaf-oil.aliasNotes: Volatile leaf oil associated with Eucalyptus globulus; keep the exact label identity.
eucalyptus-globulus-leaf-oil.distinctIngredients: An aromatic essential oil, not a nonvolatile moisturizing seed oil.

sources.label: Allergic contact dermatitis to essential oils — DermNet

glycine-soja-soybean-extract.name: Glycine Soja (Soybean) Extract
glycine-soja-soybean-extract.summary: Soybean extract used to keep skin feeling conditioned
glycine-soja-soybean-extract.body: Soybean extract is used to help keep skin in good condition. It is an extract of the beans, with a different composition from the soybean oil that may also appear in a formula.
glycine-soja-soybean-extract.distinctIngredients: Separate from Glycine Soja Oil, hydrolyzed soy protein and soybean sprout extract.

sources.label: GLYCINE SOJA EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

glycyrrhiza-glabra-licorice-root-extract.name: Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract
glycyrrhiza-glabra-licorice-root-extract.summary: Licorice root extract for a comfortable skin feel
glycyrrhiza-glabra-licorice-root-extract.body: Licorice root extract is used to help skin feel soothed and comfortable. It contains a mixture of plant compounds, including glabridin and glycyrrhizin, rather than one purified active ingredient.
glycyrrhiza-glabra-licorice-root-extract.detail: Different extracts can contain very different amounts of these compounds. That makes the exact raw material important when interpreting a product’s claims.
glycyrrhiza-glabra-licorice-root-extract.distinctIngredients: Not interchangeable with isolated glabridin, glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, or another licorice species.

helianthus-annuus-sunflower-extract.name: Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Extract
helianthus-annuus-sunflower-extract.summary: Sunflower extract that helps skin feel softer
helianthus-annuus-sunflower-extract.body: Sunflower extract helps soften and condition skin. It is a botanical extract from sunflower seeds and flowers, rather than the familiar sunflower seed oil.
helianthus-annuus-sunflower-extract.aliasNotes: Helianthus annuus extract, described as an extract of seeds and flowers.
helianthus-annuus-sunflower-extract.distinctIngredients: Separate from Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil and seed-only extract names.

himanthalia-elongata-extract.name: Himanthalia Elongata Extract
himanthalia-elongata-extract.summary: Seaweed extract used for a skin-protecting role
himanthalia-elongata-extract.body: This extract comes from Himanthalia elongata seaweed. It is used in cosmetics for a skin-protecting role, helping a formula support skin against external influences.
himanthalia-elongata-extract.evidence: Skin protecting is a broad cosmetic function; this record does not measure a particular type or amount of protection.
himanthalia-elongata-extract.aliasNotes: Extract from the thallus, or main body, of Himanthalia elongata.

sources.label: HIMANTHALIA ELONGATA EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

lactobacillus.name: Lactobacillus
lactobacillus.summary: Bacterial ingredient used to help condition skin
lactobacillus.body: Lactobacillus names a group of bacteria used as skin-conditioning ingredients. The label identifies the group, without specifying a particular strain or how the ingredient was processed.
lactobacillus.amountAndUse: The ingredient name alone does not establish that live bacteria remain in the finished product.
lactobacillus.aliasNotes: One or more Lactobacillus species; not automatically a ferment, filtrate or lysate.
lactobacillus.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from Lactobacillus Ferment and Lactobacillus Ferment Lysate.

lactobacillus-ferment.name: Lactobacillus Ferment
lactobacillus-ferment.summary: Fermentation ingredient for skin conditioning and formula care
lactobacillus-ferment.body: Lactobacillus ferment is made through fermentation using Lactobacillus bacteria. It is used to condition skin, and some preparations also help protect a cosmetic formula from microbial spoilage.
lactobacillus-ferment.amountAndUse: A ferment name does not by itself tell you whether a product contains live bacteria.
lactobacillus-ferment.aliasNotes: Product obtained through Lactobacillus fermentation; exact substrate and strain are not specified by the name.
lactobacillus-ferment.distinctIngredients: Not the same identity as Lactobacillus, a filtrate or a lysate.

lactococcus-ferment-lysate.name: Lactococcus Ferment Lysate
lactococcus-ferment-lysate.summary: Broken-down fermentation material used to condition skin
lactococcus-ferment-lysate.body: Lactococcus ferment lysate is a skin-conditioning ingredient made from fermented bacterial material. A lysate contains the contents and fragments released when cells are broken apart.
lactococcus-ferment-lysate.amountAndUse: The word lysate describes broken-down cell material, rather than a promise of live probiotics.
lactococcus-ferment-lysate.aliasNotes: Lysate of a Lactococcus fermentation product.
lactococcus-ferment-lysate.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from Lactococcus Ferment and Lactobacillus ingredients.

leuconostoc-radish-root-ferment-filtrate.name: Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate
leuconostoc-radish-root-ferment-filtrate.summary: Filtered radish ferment that supports formula preservation
leuconostoc-radish-root-ferment-filtrate.body: This ingredient is made by fermenting radish roots with Leuconostoc bacteria and filtering the resulting material. It can help control microbial growth in a formula, supporting the product’s preservation system.
leuconostoc-radish-root-ferment-filtrate.aliasNotes: Filtrate of fermented Raphanus sativus roots using Leuconostoc.
leuconostoc-radish-root-ferment-filtrate.distinctIngredients: A filtered fermentation product, not radish root extract or live-bacteria skincare.

mangifera-indica-mango-fruit-extract.name: Mangifera Indica (Mango) Fruit Extract
mangifera-indica-mango-fruit-extract.summary: Mango fruit extract used to condition skin
mangifera-indica-mango-fruit-extract.body: Mango fruit extract is used in cosmetics to help keep skin in good condition. It comes from the fruit pulp, with the extraction process determining which plant components are collected.
mangifera-indica-mango-fruit-extract.aliasNotes: Extract of Mangifera indica fruit pulp.
mangifera-indica-mango-fruit-extract.distinctIngredients: Separate from Mangifera Indica Seed Butter, seed oil and mango juice.

sources.label: Mangifera Indica Fruit Extract (with Product List)
MANGIFERA INDICA FRUIT EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

nasturtium-officinale-flower-leaf-extrac.name: Nasturtium Officinale Flower/Leaf Extract
nasturtium-officinale-flower-leaf-extrac.summary: Watercress flower-and-leaf extract for comfortable-feeling skin
nasturtium-officinale-flower-leaf-extrac.body: This watercress extract is used to help skin feel comfortable. It is made from both flowers and leaves, and its tonic role means contributing to a pleasant feeling on skin or hair.
nasturtium-officinale-flower-leaf-extrac.aliasNotes: Extract from Nasturtium officinale flowers and leaves.
nasturtium-officinale-flower-leaf-extrac.distinctIngredients: Do not merge with watercress flower/leaf/stem extract or other Nasturtium species.

sources.label: Nasturtium Officinale Flower/Leaf Extract (with Product List)
NASTURTIUM OFFICINALE FLOWER/LEAF EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

nymphaea-alba-root-extract.name: Nymphaea Alba Root Extract
nymphaea-alba-root-extract.summary: Water-lily root extract used to condition skin
nymphaea-alba-root-extract.body: This extract from white water-lily roots helps keep skin in good condition. The name identifies the root preparation, which has a different identity from extracts made from the flowers.
nymphaea-alba-root-extract.distinctIngredients: Not Nymphaea Alba Flower Extract or another water-lily species.

sources.label: Nymphaea Alba Root Extract (with Product List)
NYMPHAEA ALBA ROOT EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

ophiopogon-japonicus-root-extract.name: Ophiopogon Japonicus Root Extract
ophiopogon-japonicus-root-extract.summary: Root extract for conditioned, comfortable-feeling skin
ophiopogon-japonicus-root-extract.body: This root extract is used to condition skin and contribute to a pleasant feel. It comes from Ophiopogon japonicus, also called dwarf lilyturf, and is a plant extract rather than an oil.

sources.label: Ophiopogon Japonicus Root Extract (with Product List)
OPHIOPOGON JAPONICUS ROOT EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

oryza-sativa-rice-bran-extract.name: Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Extract
oryza-sativa-rice-bran-extract.summary: Rice bran extract used to condition skin
oryza-sativa-rice-bran-extract.body: Rice bran extract is made from the bran surrounding the rice grain. It is used to help keep skin in good condition and has a broad skin-protecting role in cosmetics.
oryza-sativa-rice-bran-extract.distinctIngredients: Separate from rice bran oil, rice water and fermented rice ingredients.

sources.label: Oryza Sativa Bran Extract (with Product List)
ORYZA SATIVA BRAN EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

panax-ginseng-root-extract.name: Panax Ginseng Root Extract
panax-ginseng-root-extract.summary: Ginseng root extract that softens and supplies antioxidants
panax-ginseng-root-extract.body: Ginseng root extract helps soften skin and provides antioxidants, substances that help limit oxidation, a chemical process that changes molecules.
panax-ginseng-root-extract.distinctIngredients: Keep separate from other ginseng species, root powder and fermented preparations.

physalis-angulata-extract.name: Physalis Angulata Extract
physalis-angulata-extract.summary: Whole-plant extract used for cosmetic skin protection
physalis-angulata-extract.body: Physalis angulata extract is used for a skin-protecting role in cosmetics. It is made from the whole plant, which distinguishes it from a fruit-only or leaf-only extract.
physalis-angulata-extract.evidence: Skin protecting describes its intended cosmetic role; the record does not quantify a particular protective effect.

sources.label: PHYSALIS ANGULATA EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

pleiogynium-timoriense-fruit-extract.name: Pleiogynium Timoriense Fruit Extract
pleiogynium-timoriense-fruit-extract.summary: Fruit extract used to help condition skin
pleiogynium-timoriense-fruit-extract.body: This extract is made from the fruit of Pleiogynium timoriense. It is used to help keep skin in good condition, as one botanical component of a finished formula.
pleiogynium-timoriense-fruit-extract.distinctIngredients: Keep species separate from Podocarpus elatus and Terminalia ferdinandiana fruit extracts.

sources.label: Pleiogynium Timoriense Fruit Extract (with Product List)
PLEIOGYNIUM TIMORIENSE FRUIT EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

podocarpus-elatus-fruit-extract.name: Podocarpus Elatus Fruit Extract
podocarpus-elatus-fruit-extract.summary: Plum-pine fruit extract used to condition skin
podocarpus-elatus-fruit-extract.body: This fruit extract comes from Podocarpus elatus, also known as plum pine. It is used in cosmetics to help keep skin in good condition.
podocarpus-elatus-fruit-extract.aliasNotes: Extract of Podocarpus elatus fruit pulp.
podocarpus-elatus-fruit-extract.distinctIngredients: Do not merge with other ingredients described broadly as plum extracts.

sources.label: Podocarpus Elatus Fruit Extract (with Product List)
PODOCARPUS ELATUS FRUIT EXTRACT – Ingredient – COSMILE Europe

rosmarinus-officinalis-rosemary-leaf-ext.name: Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract
rosmarinus-officinalis-rosemary-leaf-ext.summary: Rosemary leaf extract that helps limit oxidation
rosmarinus-officinalis-rosemary-leaf-ext.body: Rosemary leaf extract contributes antioxidant plant compounds and helps condition skin. Antioxidants help slow oxidation, a chemical process that can change other substances in a formula.
rosmarinus-officinalis-rosemary-leaf-ext.distinctIngredients: Separate from rosemary leaf essential oil, leaf water and purified rosmarinic acid.

rosmarinus-officinalis-rosemary-leaf-oil.name: Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil
rosmarinus-officinalis-rosemary-leaf-oil.summary: Rosemary essential oil that adds an herbal scent
rosmarinus-officinalis-rosemary-leaf-oil.body: Rosemary leaf oil is an aromatic essential oil used to shape a product’s smell. It is obtained from rosemary’s flowering tops and leaves, and differs from the plant’s leaf extract.
rosmarinus-officinalis-rosemary-leaf-oil.caution: Essential oils can trigger allergic skin reactions and, at high concentrations, irritation. Avoid rosemary oil if you have a known allergy to it.
