sodium-phosphate.body: Sodium Phosphate helps control the acidity of a formula. It is a buffering ingredient, meaning it supports a steadier pH rather than letting the acidity shift easily.
sodium-phosphate.aliasNotes: The read INCI record identifies Sodium Phosphate as sodium dihydrogenorthophosphate; this is not a generic card for all phosphate salts.
sodium-phosphate.distinctIngredients: Do not merge with Disodium Phosphate, Trisodium Phosphate or pyrophosphates.

sources.label: Adjustment and Stabilization/buffering of the pH-value — ICL Phosphate Specialty

sodium-phytate.name: Sodium Phytate
sodium-phytate.summary: Binds metal traces that could alter a product
sodium-phytate.body: Sodium Phytate helps trap tiny amounts of metals that can enter a formula with its raw materials. This helps limit changes in the product, such as unwanted color shifts.

sodium-stearoyl-glutamate.name: Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate
sodium-stearoyl-glutamate.summary: Helps oily and watery ingredients stay mixed
sodium-stearoyl-glutamate.body: Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate helps oil and water blend and stay together. It supports the texture and stability of creams and lotions so the mixture spreads evenly.

sorbeth-30-tetraoleate.name: Sorbeth-30 Tetraoleate
sorbeth-30-tetraoleate.summary: Helps cleansing oils mix with rinse water
sorbeth-30-tetraoleate.body: Sorbeth-30 Tetraoleate helps an oily cleanser disperse when water is added. This makes the oil easier to rinse away instead of leaving a heavy oily layer.

sorbic-acid.name: Sorbic Acid
sorbic-acid.summary: Helps stop unwanted microbes growing in formulas.
sorbic-acid.body: Sorbic Acid helps protect a product from microbial spoilage. It commonly works with other preservative ingredients, contributing to the system that keeps a formula usable during storage and repeated use.

sorbitan-isostearate.name: Sorbitan Isostearate
sorbitan-isostearate.summary: Keeps oil, water and fine particles evenly mixed
sorbitan-isostearate.body: Sorbitan Isostearate helps oil and water blend together and helps fine particles disperse. These jobs support an even product texture and help pigments spread more uniformly on skin.

sorbitan-olivate.name: Sorbitan Olivate
sorbitan-olivate.summary: Helps water and oil form a smooth lotion
sorbitan-olivate.body: Sorbitan Olivate is a mixing ingredient made from sorbitol and olive-oil fatty acids. It helps combine oil and water into a cream or lotion that stays evenly blended.
sorbitan-olivate.distinctIngredients: Sorbitan Olivate is one ingredient in some Olivem 1000 blends; the trade blend is not an alias for this ingredient alone.

sorbitan-palmitate.name: Sorbitan Palmitate
sorbitan-palmitate.summary: Helps blend ingredients and adds waxy structure
sorbitan-palmitate.body: Sorbitan Palmitate helps oil and water mix while adding body to a formula. Its waxy, solid character is useful when an oily product needs a firmer, less runny texture.

styrene-acrylates-copolymer.name: Styrene/Acrylates Copolymer
styrene-acrylates-copolymer.summary: Helps a product form a continuous surface layer
styrene-acrylates-copolymer.body: Styrene/Acrylates Copolymer helps a product leave a thin, continuous film after application. It can also make a formula look less transparent, influencing both its finish and appearance.

sucrose-laurate.name: Sucrose Laurate
sucrose-laurate.summary: Thickens oils and helps them rinse with water
sucrose-laurate.body: Sucrose Laurate helps oily ingredients mix with water and can give oils a gel-like texture. It is useful in cleansers that turn milky as water is added for rinsing.

tamarindus-indica-seed-gum.name: Tamarindus Indica Seed Gum
tamarindus-indica-seed-gum.summary: Adds body and a smooth, hydrated feel
tamarindus-indica-seed-gum.body: Tamarindus Indica Seed Gum helps thicken a formula and supports a smooth, moisturized feel on skin. This seed-derived gum can also help keep a mixed formula stable.
tamarindus-indica-seed-gum.detail: A gum is a large sugar-based material that changes how a liquid flows and feels.
tamarindus-indica-seed-gum.distinctIngredients: This card is for the seed gum, not tamarind fruit extract or other tamarind preparations.

tetrasodium-edta.name: Tetrasodium EDTA
tetrasodium-edta.summary: Binds metal traces that can disturb a formula
tetrasodium-edta.body: Tetrasodium EDTA captures tiny amounts of metals that can otherwise change a product over time. This helps the formula remain more consistent through storage and use.
tetrasodium-edta.distinctIngredients: Tetrasodium EDTA is a particular salt of EDTA; do not merge it with Disodium EDTA.

triacontanyl-pvp.name: Triacontanyl PVP
triacontanyl-pvp.summary: Forms a film and fine-tunes product texture
triacontanyl-pvp.body: Triacontanyl PVP helps create a continuous film on the skin and adjusts a product's consistency. It can also help retain moisture in the formula.
triacontanyl-pvp.detail: A film-forming polymer works at the product's surface, helping the applied layer hold together.

triethanolamine.name: Triethanolamine
triethanolamine.summary: Sets a formula's acidity to its intended range
triethanolamine.body: Triethanolamine helps adjust a product's pH, which describes how acidic or alkaline it is. This supports the conditions that the other ingredients need to work and stay properly formulated.

triethoxycaprylylsilane.name: Triethoxycaprylylsilane
triethoxycaprylylsilane.summary: Helps coated particles disperse and spread evenly
triethoxycaprylylsilane.body: Triethoxycaprylylsilane is used to coat fine particles such as pigments. That coating helps them stay dispersed in a formula and spread more evenly as the product is applied.

triethyl-citrate.name: Triethyl Citrate
triethyl-citrate.summary: Supports fragrance blends and keeps films flexible
triethyl-citrate.body: Triethyl Citrate supports fragrance blends and helps make brittle cosmetic films softer and more flexible. These jobs let formulators adjust a product's scent system and the feel of its finish.
triethyl-citrate.distinctIngredients: Triethyl Citrate is a citric-acid ester, not Citric Acid or a citrate salt.

trilaureth-4-phosphate.name: Trilaureth-4 Phosphate
trilaureth-4-phosphate.summary: Helps oily and watery ingredients blend together
trilaureth-4-phosphate.body: Trilaureth-4 Phosphate helps oil and water form an even mixture. Its mixing action can support a consistent formula, allowing oily ingredients to be spread with the water-based portion.

trisodium-ethylenediamine-disuccinate.name: Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate
trisodium-ethylenediamine-disuccinate.summary: Captures metal traces that can alter a product
trisodium-ethylenediamine-disuccinate.body: Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate helps bind tiny amounts of metals in a formula. This helps limit unwanted changes during storage, keeping the product more consistent.
trisodium-ethylenediamine-disuccinate.detail: It is particularly useful for binding traces of copper and iron.

triticum-vulgare-wheat-starch.name: Triticum Vulgare (Wheat) Starch
triticum-vulgare-wheat-starch.summary: Absorbs material and gives formulas more body
triticum-vulgare-wheat-starch.body: Wheat Starch helps absorb material and adjust how thick or powdery a product feels. It can also help powdered ingredients hold together, contributing to a more consistent texture.
triticum-vulgare-wheat-starch.aliasNotes: The wheat-derived starch preparation, retaining the roster's parenthetical common name.
triticum-vulgare-wheat-starch.distinctIngredients: Wheat starch is not wheat germ oil, wheat protein or hydrolyzed wheat protein.

zea-mays-corn-starch.name: Zea Mays (Corn) Starch
zea-mays-corn-starch.summary: Reduces greasy feel and smooths product texture
zea-mays-corn-starch.body: Corn Starch is a powder that helps a formula feel less greasy or sticky. It can add body and a softer finish, making a rich product easier to spread.

zinc-chloride.name: Zinc Chloride
zinc-chloride.summary: Adds an astringent feel and helps control microbes
zinc-chloride.body: Zinc Chloride is a zinc salt used for its astringent properties, meaning it can give skin a temporarily tightened feel. It also has a microbial-growth-control role in cosmetic formulas.
zinc-chloride.distinctIngredients: Zinc Chloride is not Zinc Oxide or Zinc PCA; claims for those other zinc ingredients do not transfer automatically.

ceramide_np.name: Ceramide NP
ceramide_np.summary: Adds a skin fat that helps retain moisture
ceramide_np.body: Ceramide NP is another fat used to support skin’s outer protective layer. That layer helps stop moisture from escaping too quickly.
ceramide_np.detail: NP, AP and EOP name different types of ceramides. The letters are not quality grades. Ceramides work with other fats and moisturizing ingredients, so more ceramide names do not automatically mean a better product.
ceramide_np.evidence: Research on ceramides and ceramide mixtures supports this role. It does not isolate NP’s effect in either lotion.

ceramide_ap.name: Ceramide AP
ceramide_ap.summary: Supports the skin layer that holds moisture
ceramide_ap.body: Ceramide AP is a fat used to support skin’s outer protective layer. It is one part of the mixture that helps skin hold onto moisture.
ceramide_ap.detail: AP names a particular type of ceramide. It works alongside other skin fats, water-holding ingredients and skin softeners. Its presence adds to the formula’s makeup without proving a separate extra benefit.
ceramide_ap.evidence: The role of the ceramide family is established. A unique benefit from AP in either lotion is not established.

ceramide_eop.name: Ceramide EOP
ceramide_eop.summary: Adds a skin fat that helps keep water in
ceramide_eop.body: Ceramide EOP is a type of fat found in skin’s outer protective layer. In a moisturizer, it is used to support that layer and help skin keep moisture in.
ceramide_eop.detail: It is also known by the older name Ceramide 1. Ceramides work within a mixture of skin fats; their amount and how they are combined matter as well as their names.
ceramide_eop.evidence: The role of ceramides in skin is established. An ingredient list does not show how well the complete product supports that protective layer.
ceramide_eop.aliasNotes: It is also known by the older name Ceramide 1. Ceramides work within a mixture of skin fats; their amount and how they are combined matter as well as their names.

hyaluronic_acid.name: Hyaluronic Acid
hyaluronic_acid.summary: Holds water at the skin’s surface
hyaluronic_acid.body: Hyaluronic acid holds water at the skin’s surface. That can help skin feel hydrated and look temporarily smoother.
hyaluronic_acid.detail: Different sizes of the molecule can be used in skincare. The ingredient name does not reveal which sizes or how much are in a product, so it cannot establish deeper penetration or lasting wrinkle improvement.
hyaluronic_acid.evidence: Its water-holding role is well established. The amount and molecule size affect how it works.

sodium_hyaluronate.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
sodium_hyaluronate.summary: Helps keep the skin’s surface hydrated
sodium_hyaluronate.body: Sodium hyaluronate is a form of hyaluronic acid that helps skin hold water. It can make the surface feel hydrated and smoother.
sodium_hyaluronate.detail: It is the salt form of hyaluronic acid, a related but distinct ingredient. Different molecule sizes can be used. Neither name on a label tells you which product will moisturize better.
sodium_hyaluronate.evidence: Its water-holding role is well established. The naming difference does not prove better absorption or results.

ceramide_ng.name: Ceramide NG
ceramide_ng.summary: Adds another fat used in skin’s outer layer
ceramide_ng.body: Ceramide NG is a type of skin-related fat used to support the outer layer that keeps moisture in. It works as part of a moisturizer’s wider mix of ingredients.
ceramide_ng.detail: It belongs to the ceramide family, but has its own chemical structure. An additional ceramide can be a useful part of a blend; counting its name does not tell us how much extra benefit the blend provides.
ceramide_ng.evidence: The reference describes the ceramide family’s role. It does not establish a separate NG-specific result in this product.

ceramide_as.name: Ceramide AS
ceramide_as.summary: Helps keep skin in good condition
ceramide_as.body: Ceramide AS is a skin-related fat used to help keep skin in good condition. It belongs to the same broad family as the other ceramides in this lotion.
ceramide_as.detail: Its basic role is documented, but there is less direct detail about what AS alone adds. That supports a modest skin-care description rather than a promise of a specific repair benefit.
ceramide_as.evidence: Its identity and skin-care use are documented. The reviewed AS-specific benefit evidence is limited.
